caption: The drawing features a light brown, cylindrical clay jar with a wide mouth, slightly outward-flaring rim, and two small rounded handles on opposite sides near the upper section. The jar displays a hand-painted blue decorative motif resembling a stylized tree with a straight trunk and symmetrical, curved branches ending in dots or short lines. Beneath the motif, the year "1835" is painted in blue. The interior of the jar appears darker brown. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, detailed inset showing a close-up of the rim and a partial handle, providing a different view of the jar's surface and texture. The background is a plain off-white, emphasizing the jar, and there is a thin, rectangular border enclosing the objects. Near the lower right corner, the artist's name "N. Amantea" is signed.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
